parameters.formDescription: OpenAI TTS per narration/dialogue line, mixed per shot. Empty ids = only missing audio.

parameters.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json, os, sys
req = json.loads(base64.b64decode("{{ $json.payloadB64 }}").decode("utf-8"))
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + req["slug"]
spath = os.path.join(root, "script.json")
if not os.path.exists(spath):
    print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "no script.json in " + root + " — run the Script stage first"}))
    sys.exit(1)
script = json.load(open(spath))
chars = {c["id"]: c for c in script.get("characters", [])}
VOICES = {"alloy", "ash", "coral", "echo", "fable", "onyx", "nova", "sage", "shimmer"}
override = req.get("tts_model") or "auto"
if override not in ("gpt-4o-mini-tts", "tts-1"):
    override = None
regen = set(req.get("regen_ids") or [])
lines = []
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        pending = []
        if shot.get("narration"):
            pending.append({"text": shot["narration"], "voice": script.get("narrator_voice", "fable"),
                            "instructions": script.get("narrator_instructions", ""), "model": "gpt-4o-mini-tts"})
        k = 1
        for d in shot.get("dialogue") or []:
            k += 1
            c = chars.get(d.get("character", ""), {})
            pending.append({"text": d.get("text", ""), "voice": c.get("voice", "fable"),
                            "instructions": c.get("tts_instructions", ""), "model": c.get("tts_model", "gpt-4o-mini-tts")})
        seq = 0
        for item in pending:
            seq += 1
            lid = sid + "_L%02d" % seq
            out_rel = "audio/lines/" + lid + ".mp3"
            exists = os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, out_rel))
            if exists and sid not in regen:
                continue
            text = (item["text"] or "").strip()[:4000]
            if not text:
                continue
            voice = item["voice"] if item["voice"] in VOICES else "fable"
            model = override or item.get("model") or "gpt-4o-mini-tts"
            lines.append({"slug": req["slug"], "shotId": sid, "lineId": lid, "text": text,
                          "voice": voice, "tts_model": model,
                          "instructions": (item.get("instructions") or "").strip()[:500], "outPath": out_rel})
print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "slug": req["slug"], "lines": lines}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY

parameters.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, datetime, json, os, subprocess
req = json.loads(base64.b64decode("{{ $json.payloadB64 }}").decode("utf-8"))
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + req["slug"]
script = json.load(open(os.path.join(root, "script.json")))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "audio"), exist_ok=True)
sil = "/tmp/n8nfilm_sil.mp3"
if not os.path.exists(sil):
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=24000:cl=mono",
                    "-t", "0.25", "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "6", sil], check=True)
durations = {}
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        line_files = []
        if shot.get("narration"):
            line_files.append(os.path.join(root, "audio", "lines", sid + "_L01.mp3"))
        k = 1
        for _ in shot.get("dialogue") or []:
            k += 1
            line_files.append(os.path.join(root, "audio", "lines", sid + "_L%02d.mp3" % k))
        line_files = [p for p in line_files if os.path.exists(p)]
        if not line_files:
            continue
        lst = "/tmp/n8nfilm_mix_" + sid + ".txt"
        with open(lst, "w") as fh:
            for j, p in enumerate(line_files):
                if j:
                    fh.write("file '" + sil + "'\n")
                fh.write("file '" + p + "'\n")
        out = os.path.join(root, "audio", sid + ".mp3")
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", lst,
                        "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "4", "-ar", "24000", "-ac", "1", out], check=True)
        p = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", out],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        durations[sid] = round(float(p.stdout.strip()), 3)
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
pf = os.path.join(root, "project.json")
proj = json.load(open(pf)) if os.path.exists(pf) else {}
proj.update({"status": "voice_ready", "updated_at": now})
proj.setdefault("stages", {})["voiceover"] = {"status": "done", "done_at": now, "durations": durations}
with open(pf, "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "durations": durations}))
PY
